finalText: Migration's done. All 12 stragglers — one repo file each in analytics, orders, billing, support, catalog, and accounts — now call `db.execute({ sql, params })` instead of `db.query`. The `cache.query` calls and `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` were left alone since they're not part of this. `node verify.js` confirms it: every call site moved, and the modules still run correctly.
